title: CS Resources & Equipment Database
description: The CS Resources & Equipment Database is a web-based system built for the University of the Philippines Diliman – College of Science (UPD-CS). It provides a centralized platform for managing, monitoring, and sharing equipment across laboratories and institutes. Designed to promote sustainability, accountability, and inter-institute collaboration, the system enables faculty members to efficiently access, track, and manage institutional resources.
summary: A shared home for laboratory resources across UP Diliman’s College of Science.

title: CS Centralized Portal
description: The CS Centralized Portal is a web-based platform developed for the University of the Philippines Diliman – College of Science (UPD-CS). It serves as the main system for academic and administrative document processing, aiming to eliminate traditional manual workflows and centralize services for faculty, staff, and students.
summary: Academic and administrative document workflows, brought into one portal.

title: Aimporo Business Technologies, Inc.
description:
Designed and created a digital marketplace for entrepreneurs. It discusses software products and services to help solopreneurs and businesses grow.

The website offers Excel templates, software tools, and masterclasses. Some of the products include financial trackers, invoice generators, and project management tools.
summary: A digital marketplace and productivity tools for entrepreneurs.

title: PWise
description: P-Wise: Smart Budgeting System aims to help users to budget and track the salary and expenses of one household and its members or even for personal use.
summary: Budget planning and expense tracking for households and individuals.

title: Tsibugan St.
description:
Developed as my Capstone Project at AMA Computer College Caloocan Campus.

This E-commerce website for Tsibugan St. enhances credibility, expands market reach, and streamlines product promotion. It ensures seamless transactions with integrated online payments (e.g., Gcash, GrabPay, and Maya) and provides comprehensive management tools for orders, products, stocks, and sales.
summary: Online ordering, e-wallet payments, and store management for Tsibugan St.

title: Aqua Pura
description:
Aqua Pura is a Water Refilling Station is located in Quezon City.

Developed an online ordering system with reservation and online e-wallet payments using Paymongo payment gateway.
summary: Water refilling orders, reservations, and online e-wallet payments.

title: Property Requirements PH
description: Property Requirements PH envision helping brokers and clients easily find the right listing for them. Our users can specify the requirements and the budget they are looking for to match with brokers. From condominiums to houses, apartments, and more, we provide a wide range of listings that users can adjust to fit their preferences. We are a platform where they can easily connect, resulting in efficiency and a hassle-free experience.
summary: Connecting property requirements and budgets with brokers and listings.

title: HANAWAN National High School Verification and Enrollment System
description:
A Web Based Online Portal for HANAWAN National High School to have an online enrollment with verification of old/new students.

Students module, teachers module, admins module, grading module and verifications module.
summary: An enrollment and verification portal for students, teachers, and administrators.
